correctness.rationale: For A,B permutations and swap set S, inverse reversibility is equivalent in both output fibers to A(S)=B(S), or invariance under A^-1 B. For each fixed k-subset S there are n! choices of A and k!(n-k)! of B; choose S gives (n!)^2. Each connected transition component is invariant under A,B because they are permutations; the weighted labeled-component exponential formula proves the formal-log exact connected counts and finite recurrence. Exhaustive direct-definition checker verifies all 470322 reversible invertible binary tables through n=5 and recurrence through n=9. Formal proof covers all n.

value.rationale: Complete exact statistics for an all-size, natural family of finite-state reversible transducers, separating a surprising uniform distribution of switch counts from the nonuniform connected distribution. Strongly connected bireversible tables are a motivated subclass in automaton-group investigations, and the exact recurrence enables unbiased model counts at every n without table-level brute force; this is more than a tiny finite count or renaming of known values.
